gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on 2026-11-11 Belkin's own US store lists the UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 as out of stock until Nov 22 at $129.99, while the ESR CryoBoost 25W is in stock at $109.99 and ESR's 15 W CryoBoost 3-in-1 is $59.99.
standout_why: Compared against Macworld's best-MagSafe roundup (cited; the readable part names only the Mophie 3-in-1 at $149.95, with no fan, noise or temperature figures), Macworld's ESR CryoBoost 25W review (cited; gives $119.99 list / $99.99 Amazon from Oct 2025, Belkin at $129.99, and the 15 W ESR at 'around $80 or less') and Macworld's UGREEN MagFlow Pro review (uncited; $159.99, no rival prices). None gives today's stock status or one dated price table across the fan-cooled 3-in-1s; Macworld already has part of the 15 W ESR point. Two cited pages could not be read (Digital Camera World's Anker Prime review returned only its headline, TechGearDen failed on a certificate error), so the comparison against them is incomplete and the score could be 1 if either carries a current price table.
decides: Confirms ESR CryoBoost 25W as the pick: it is the cheapest fan-cooled 25 W 3-in-1 priced today, $20 under Belkin, $40 under Anker Prime Foldable and $120 under Anker Prime Dock Stand. It weakens ChatGPT's third pick, because 'Shop Belkin' leads to an out-of-stock page until Nov 22. It adds a branch ChatGPT's own closing question implies: an iPhone 15 or older tops out at 15 W, so ESR's 15 W CryoBoost 3-in-1 at $59.99 gives the fan for $50 less.
